question: Where does the sound arising from the lower center undergo dissolution?
premises: The sound arises from the anus place
The sound reaches the end of the twelve
The sound undergoes dissolution again at that point
inference: The sound that rises from the lower center dissolves again at the twelvefold end
uncertainties: The exact referent of dvādaśa-ante is not specified in this verse
plain_english: Arising from the anus-place, it again dissolves at the end of the twelve.
